=== Build notes ===

* Relabelled the supplementary source catalogue External links; existing facts, decks and links were retained apart from the citation repair below.
* Corrected only the citation for Eric’s second place at the 2000 Kashyyyk Regionals. [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320id_/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Decipher’s qualifier list] names champion Steve Brentson but does not name Eric as runner-up. Eric’s already-cited tournament report explicitly calls him the runner-up and records his 12 +110 behind Steve’s 12 +135. The second-place result, event date and decks are unchanged; the cell now uses the existing tr-d1025 reference. The original Decipher capture is retained as a historical artifact in task 719.
* Source and original-version preservation remains pending under the existing serialized owner. Independent backups and registrations do not imply verified Archive captures.
